world.title: US envoys meet Zelensky in Dublin after talks with Putin in Moscow
world.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff says President Putin has agreed to European negotiators joining the next round of Ukraine talks.

world.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
world.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

world.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
world.description: Schools across Italy have received bomb threats for the second day in a row, sparking fresh panic and evacuations.

world.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
world.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

world.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
world.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

world.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
world.description: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

world.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
world.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

world.title: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas
world.description: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.

world.title: Oranges investigated after four girls die in suspected Uganda school poisoning
world.description: The girls started vomiting after eating oranges brought in by a fellow pupil - police are travelling to the village they came from.

world.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
world.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

world.title: Search for British woman missing from Tui cruise in Atlantic called off
world.description: The 72-year-old is believed to have gone overboard from the Tui ship on Monday as it headed towards the Caribbean.

world.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
world.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

world.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
world.description: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".

world.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
world.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

world.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
world.description: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

US.title: Cindy Holscher wins in Kansas, holding governor's office for Democrats
US.description: Holscher, a state senator, overcame a more well-known Republican who had Trump's endorsement in the state that has gone to the GOP in most other statewide races.

US.title: What's a Honey Trap? The spy tactic that helped topple Jensen Huang
US.description: Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, the leading AI chipmaker, resigned after admitting an extramarital affair with a woman the U.S. says is a Chinese spy. This espionage tactic is known as a honey trap.

US.title: 'Punch in the gut': Homes sales fall to their lowest in 16 years
US.description: Existing homes sales in October declined 8.8% from a year earlier, according to the National Association of Realtors.

US.title: Casualties continue to rise after Brooklyn building collapses
US.description: First responders continue to search for survivors after a building in Brooklyn collapsed, leaving at least eight dead and dozens injured.

US.title: Democrats want to stop Trump's arch, golf course and more. What are their options?
US.description: As Trump's arch and other projects make their way through the courts, many critics are looking to Congress to stop them. Democrats have a few tools, including funding and oversight.

US.title: The SS United States takes its final voyage to the bottom of the Gulf of Mexico
US.description: A ship bigger than the Titanic is being sunk off the coast of Florida to make an artificial reef.

US.title: Witnesses describe the D.C. shooting that left 1 dead, 4 injured
US.description: A gunman opened fire at a gym in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle Thursday morning. One person has been confirmed killed and four others injured. The gunman is dead, according to police.

US.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in the Kremlin after Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
US.description: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff went to the Kremlin to brief Russian President Vladimir Putin and are scheduled to fly later to Ireland for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

US.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
US.description: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.
